title: 杭州商场出租率90%：写字楼却慢，谁在抢租？
speaker: Adriel Chan

segments.en: When do you expect that to become fully operational? So we're actually about 90% leased right now, and we'll be opening the last 10% over the next few months.
segments.zh: 您预计何时全面运营？目前出租率约90%，最后10%将在未来几个月内开业。

segments.en: So we're actually moving very quickly on this one. It's relatively unusual, especially in this market, to open a mall with such a high occupancy.
segments.zh: 我们推进得很快。在当前市场环境下，以如此高的出租率开业是相当罕见的。

segments.en: What about the office component? So the offices are a little bit slower. We were very happy to announce one of the five blocks was fully leased to one tenant at the time of opening the mall. But we still have one or two towers, which are waiting to be opened. The other three coming along, but definitely slower, they're hoping.
segments.zh: 写字楼部分呢？写字楼进展稍慢。我们很高兴宣布，商场开业时五栋楼中有一栋已整租给单一租户。但还有一两栋塔楼待开业，另外三栋在推进中，但速度明显较慢。
